scope: strict versioned chat DTOs and JSON endpoints
atomic exact existing Foundation proposal approval

validation.tests: delegated to GAUNTLET; no test authoring or test execution by core worker

authority.providerSubmission: existing one-request task and Foundation reservation
authority.progress: current lease plus real grant dispatch check; source vendor sequence dedup; no raw vendor IDs in browser events
authority.artifact: UTF8 only; immutable digest checked in detail/download; server-generated filename
authority.proposal: existing requiresApproval same-scope plan only; no enqueue/new plan/model self-approval
authority.approval: fresh owner, exact hash/target/revision/command/profile/source task/epoch/expiry; real Foundation approval and proposal decision share serialized transaction
authority.rejection: protective authenticated owner action, no fresh-stepup needed, no grant
authority.readOnly: owner history survives scope/profile drift, never renews execution authority
authority.outputs: Only actual successful Foundation settlement transaction creates artifacts/proposals; current profile/scope/epoch rechecked
authority.eventReplay: Conversation cursor and bounded event page read under the same serialized write-lock snapshot; no task/provider submission

integration.rootOwns: SSE, download transport, response validator, UI, docs
